title: Buddy Bowden and possible recordings
summary: Zardis never heard Bowden; talk of Bowden's tune, George Washington and Morris French, and rumored home recordings.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: I guess you never heard Bowden? No, no. Did you hear of him, or did you hear of him recently? No.
I never heard of Bowden. I hear lots of talk.
Yeah, what did you hear of him?

Well, I don't know what kind of great musician he was. Yeah, I said he was number one. What I mean they had, the boy was humming a song that he used to, uh, play all the time. What, I said, uh, what Buddy Bowden said, I think about, I think about take it away. That's what used to be his number, you know. That's one of his main numbers, and that's what they used to, the boy used to hum it all the time. I said, what was the thing I said, that's what Buddy Bowden used to play.
Um, did I have to play with, um, with Buddy Bowden?

Yeah, well, I played a while there, but we had George Washington. George was the main man. See, George Washington played with us all the while. It was just when George couldn't play while he did how well, you know.
He was a pretty good comment man, wasn't he? Was that, O.O? Oh, yeah.
Yeah, it was a nice time up here.
Mm-hmm.
And, uh, they had another fellow, he used to work with, uh, with Buddy, uh, Morris French, you know what I heard of? Yeah. Great man. I guess he's dead now, isn't he?
Oh, yeah, he's been dead quite a while. Well, he did nice.
He's a nice musician. Yeah, I think you made my new record. Yeah.
There was some story out there somewhere that there was a possibility that Buddy Bowden had made some records just for a home recording machine.
Well, I never had made any, all the while I was with Buddy, I didn't make no recording with Buddy.

There was some story, you made some in Thibodeau. That was in some book somewhere that nobody had ever found them, you know. So, nobody knows that they really did. Mm-hmm. Did you ever play with them there, or? In Thibodeau?
Yeah. Yeah, but we didn't make no recording, though. There was somebody just do like to come in here and steal it.
Yeah, I don't, I don't mean...
Yeah, like that.
I don't mean, you know, like a big recording company, but, you know, they used to have home recording machines, I think, in those days.
Well, it might have been, but we didn't know nothing about it. Yeah.
